close_reason: Fixed: MdnSendResult and MdnBackend::send_mdns changed from HashMap<Id,_> to HashMap<String,_>; all Id-to-String conversions in handle_mdn_send removed
description: MdnSendResult.sent and .not_sent use HashMap<Id, _> but the keys are client creation IDs (user-assigned strings). Id is a server-assigned JMAP identifier. If Id has any normalization or truncation, creation IDs like 'k1546' survive fine today, but a creation ID containing characters invalid in a JMAP Id could be silently mangled. The trait contract (send_mdns takes HashMap<Id, Mdn>) forces all backend implementors to use Id for creation IDs — an incorrect type for this namespace. Trigger: creation ID with characters outside the JMAP Id character set. Bad behavior: silently mangled key, causing notSent to fail to match in the response map.
title: MdnSendResult keys are Id not String for client creation IDs
